phase_0.boundary_condition: The Fly's Eye detector aperture and the GZK cutoff horizon that bounds observable ultra-high-energy cosmic ray origins

⊢.justification: The state before the ultra-high-energy proton exists — no particle, no trajectory, no cascade, no measurement

⊣.justification: The detector's finite acceptance solid angle and energy threshold that closes the system by terminating the cascade and fixing the measurement record

≻.justification: The forward morphism of the proton traveling at ~0.999999999999c through 3D intergalactic space from source to Earth, deflected by magnetic fields but continuing toward the atmosphere

≺.justification: The backward inference from ground-level shower footprint to primary energy and arrival direction — a contravariant mapping from effect to cause

⋈.justification: Sequential chaining of interaction lengths: each nuclear collision produces secondaries that travel one radiation/interaction length before the next collision, composing the full longitudinal shower profile

⊙.justification: The proton's invariant mass and charge are preserved across all reference frames — the particle knows itself identically throughout propagation and interaction

∈.justification: The primary proton's first inelastic collision with an atmospheric nucleus splits the cascade into a hadronic arm (pion production, muons) and an electromagnetic arm (π⁰→γγ, pair production, bremsstrahlung)

∋.justification: At detector level, the hadronic and electromagnetic components arrive simultaneously and are measured as a single combined signal — the arms rejoin into one recorded event

⊤.justification: The affirmative arm: detection of muons and hadrons confirms the hadronic cascade branch was realized

⊥.justification: The negative arm: detection of electrons, positrons, and photons confirms the electromagnetic cascade branch was realized

⊞.justification: The reconstructed primary mass (proton vs iron) remains in a B-state: both light and heavy compositions are simultaneously consistent with the measured shower fluctuations and muon content

⊡.justification: The 1991 October 15 event written to magnetic tape — permanent, append-only, cannot be undone, fixes the measurement in the scientific record

phase_3.false_description: Electromagnetic cascade confirmed: electron/photon cascade detected, radiation-length scaling observed, primary energy deposited in EM channel
phase_3.both_description: Composition paradox held live: shower fluctuations and muon excess simultaneously support proton and iron primaries — the GZK-violating energy makes both hypotheses constructively true and false at once

Compose propagation segments — each deflection and energy loss step chains to the next across ~100 Mpc
First atmospheric interaction — the proton collides with a nitrogen/oxygen nucleus at ~15 km altitude, forking into hadronic and electromagnetic arms
Affirm hadronic arm — charged pions decay to muons, neutral pions feed EM arm, nuclear fragments continue hadronic cascade
Propagate hadronic arm — muons travel to ground with minimal energy loss; hadronic core continues nuclear interactions
Chain hadronic interaction lengths — each nuclear collision produces next generation of secondaries
Affirm electromagnetic arm — π⁰→γγ initiates pair production and bremsstrahlung cascade in radiation lengths
Propagate electromagnetic arm — exponential growth to shower maximum at ~8 km, then attenuation

Hold composition paradice — measured muon count and shower fluctuations simultaneously affirm proton and iron primaries (B-state)
Rejoin at detector — hadronic muons and electromagnetic e±/γ arrive simultaneously at Fly's Eye mirrors
Reverse reconstruct — from ground signal infer primary energy (3.2×10²⁰ eV) and arrival direction via time-reversed shower model
⋈: Medium-fidelity measurement — energy and direction reconstructed reliably; composition and source remain uncertain
Fix event record — write the 1991 October 15 event to permanent archival storage
Close at detector aperture — the Fly's Eye acceptance boundary terminates the process; no further propagation possible
Close self-referential loop — the recorded event now exists as its own reference for all future UHECR studies

phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Particle cascades communicate via energy-momentum conservation at each vertex; detector channels communicate via optical fiber timing and ADC readout

phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Causal ordering by light-cone propagation: emission → propagation → first interaction → cascade steps → ground arrival → trigger → readout → recording
phase_5.alfs_store: The 1991 Fly's Eye event record (Run 2721, Event 1447) — the canonical bootstrap for all UHECR physics above 10²⁰ eV

phase_6.cycle_cost: ~3×10²⁰ eV primary energy dissipated as ionization, heat, Cherenkov light, and neutrinos; ~10⁴ J deposited in atmosphere
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Single coherent ultra-high-energy proton in near-vacuum intergalactic space; low entropy, high free energy
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Billions of thermalized secondary particles distributed across km-scale atmospheric volume; permanent bit record in detector archive
